name: RPGMP: Retrieving the Ruby
storyline: You control Actor 001, the first face you see when making a game in VX Ace. After being called up to his bosses throne room, he's told that the Ruby holding the world together is slowly fading due to nobody making any cult-classic games in RPGMVXA (damn 2000 'n MV), so now it's his goal to... uh... grab the gem and destroy it to get this whole "end of the world thing" over and done with.
summary: RPGMP: Retrieving the Ruby is an RPG Maker VX game with ACTUAL RPG mechanics, some cool dialogue and a retrievable ruby!
